name: Returns & Reverse Logistics core scenarios
description: Real Returns & Reverse Logistics Q&A pairs grounded in synthetic seed data: monthly channel return rates, category return reasons, reverse disposition recovery, and industry return rate benchmarks.

parts.text: What was the return rate percentage and returned units for E-Commerce Storefront in July 2026?

In July 2026, E-Commerce Storefront (CHN-001) had a return rate of 21.0%, with 9,450 returned units out of 45,000 gross sales units, representing $472,500.00 in returned value and an average restock turnaround of 6.5 days.
What are the primary return reasons and returned units for Apparel across channels in July 2026?

In July 2026, the primary return reason for Apparel across all channels was 'Wrong Size', totaling 9,600 units (4,200 units from E-Commerce Storefront, 3,100 units from App Mobile Application, 1,400 units from South Regional Outlets, 1,200 units from Midwest Flagship Stores, and 900 units from West Coast Boutique). Item Not as Pictured also contributed 2,100 returned units in E-Commerce.
What is the breakdown of reverse logistics disposition types and recovered value for E-Commerce Storefront in July 2026?

For E-Commerce Storefront in July 2026, reverse logistics disposition breakdown was: Restock for Resale accounted for 5,200 units ($260,000.00 recovered value), Refurbish/Repair accounted for 1,800 units ($72,000.00 recovered value), Liquidation/Jobber accounted for 1,400 units ($28,000.00 recovered value), Return to Vendor (RTV) accounted for 400 units ($20,000.00 recovered value), and Recycle/Scrap accounted for 650 units ($0.00 recovered value). Additionally, 45 policy abuse flags were recorded.
How does our online e-commerce return rate compare to overall retail industry e-commerce return rate benchmarks?

Our online E-Commerce Storefront return rate of 21.0% is aligned with retail industry benchmarks, where online apparel and softlines e-commerce return rates typically range from 20% to 30%, compared to 8% to 12% for physical retail stores.
